lines.en: label mollycafe25:
scene mollycleaning1
: Guh...
It’s dark by the time I make it to the cafe.
Molly, still attempting to put the pieces of herself together after losing several of them recently, has spent the last ten minutes wiping down the same spot on the counter without realizing it.
I think about informing her but, at this point, I’m curious to see whether or not she can manage cleaning it so thoroughly that it burns a hole into the bar.
I imagine that we are at least another ten minutes away from anything like that happening, unfortunately.
: Keep it up, Molly. Just a little while longer until your goal is accomplished.
scene mollycleaning2
: Are you kidding, Sir? We’ve been closed for ten minutes already and there are still guests inside. I am never going home.
: At this rate, my long rest is going to turn into a short rest and I’m not even going to recover all of my hit points.
: Do you have any idea how low my health is right now? A leaf could fall on my foot and knock me unconscious.
: Sounds like a big leaf.
scene mollycleaning3
: Hah. Getting eliminated by nature certainly would be an ironic way to go after spending most of my life indoors.
: If only I had listened to my father and went outside to play with all of the “normal” kids more often.
: I’m a little confused about what a “normal” Molly would even be like.
scene mollycleaning4
: Probably a little like the abnormal one, but less loud and better at not destroying friendships.
: Yeah. I figured that might have had something to do with your unenthusiastic demeanor tonight.
: Unenthusiastic demeanor?
: You’ve been wiping the counter for ten minutes now.
: It’s really dirty.
: In just one spot?
: Yes.
: Molly, come on. You’re not fooling anyone.
scene mollycleaning5
: Okay, yeah. So maybe I am a little less...rambunctious than normal. But my inability to maintain long lasting relationships isn’t a part of that, Sir.
: I’ve simply been losing sleep lately.
: Right. And why are you losing sleep, Molly?
scene mollycleaning6
: Why, gaming of course!
: I don’t have time to grieve over my missteps when I have alts to level and fictional characters to put my fictional penis inside of!
: Yes, I can see now how valuable your time truly is.
: Are you sure that’s it, though?
scene mollycleaning7
: You’re showing an awful lot of concern tonight when you normally seem to completely overlook me, Sir.
: I never overlook you. You’re just a little more exhausting to spend time with than most of the other girls.
: That makes sense.
: Plus, I always manage to be around people when they’re at the worst of their worst, and I’d like to avoid that with you if at all possible.
: You already found me at the worst of my worst when I was...admiring Rin’s Instagram.
: Was that really the worst?
: Not at the time, but I imagine the embarrassment will linger in my mind far longer than what I am experiencing now.
: That sounds...surprisingly mature for you.
scene mollycleaning8
: Then I suppose it would be for the best if I were to compare it to yet another reference to a video game you have never played in hopes that you will somehow understand what I’m talking about.
: That’s the Molly I know.
: This whole thing with Rin is like a bout of resurrection sickness.
: For a little while, everything is going to hurt a lot more than normal. And I’m going to have to be more careful about the things I do and...who I party up with.
: But that will fade over time.
: I just need to go AFK for a little while. Or put myself on autorun against the corner of a wall or something like that.
: Well, if anything, you have definitely succeeded in getting me lost.
scene mollycleaning9
: You know...the worst part of all of it isn’t that she’s with someone else now. Or that things between us will take a long time to get back to normal.
: It’s the embarrassment of what happened. And the moments at work where our eyes meet and we have to quickly look in opposite directions to avoid feeling awkward around one another.
: It’s like a scene out of the end of a visual novel, where two characters who were once close have grown apart and don’t want to stop each other from going their separate ways.
: Who are you and what have you done with Molly?
scene mollycleaning10
: Gah! I’m sorry, okay?! The sleep deprivation is making me more mature than I want to be!
scene mollycleaning11
: Besides, just because the hardest part isn’t what I expected doesn’t mean the whole thing isn’t hard at all.
: It sucks. I hate it times a million and I want these stupid human feelings to leave my body so I can go back to focusing on games and nothing but games.
: Maybe preserve a little bit of that focus for work, though.
: Haruka will be mad if you clean a hole into her bar.
scene mollycleaning3
: Hah. To tell ya the truth...I haven’t really been a great employee as of late.
: What? You? No...
scene mollycleaning2
: Okay. I haven’t been a great employee as of...ever.
: But I’ve been even worse lately.
: Honestly, Sir? I think I would have been fired already if Haruka didn’t understand, to some extent, the feelings I am so unfortunately...feeling right now.
: Then the least you can do is not destroy her belongings.
scene mollycleaning4
: Sir, may I ask you a question?
: Does being disliked and being bad at your job ever keep you awake at night?
: I thought it was gaming that was keeping you awake at night?
: Well...yes. It is.
: Games certainly are the most prominent cause of my current lack of energy, but there are times that I have to lay in bed where I can’t just...escape it all.
: At least not until the NerveGear is actually developed and I can just full dive into a completely different world and start over from zero.
scene mollycleaning12
: Ooh! If that ever happens, you should come with me!
: If what happens? I think you forgot that not everyone understands your lingo again.
: A virtual reality helmet that lets you live a completely new life inside of a virtual realm!
: Think of all the amazing things you could do there!
: I could finally have sex with an elf...
scene mollycleaning13
: Oooh, an elf lover.
: Hey, no one mentioned love. I just want to bang one.
: Luckily for you, NPCs are incapable of love! And in a fictional setting, they’d probably be easier to woo as well!
: Not that you have any issue with wooing women or anything. I mean, you are the Herald of the Adolescents, after all.
: I’m just going to assume that this section of the conversation is over and that I have your full support when it comes to interspecies sexual intercourse.
scene mollycleaning14
: Of course, Sir! In fact, I have a lengthy list of h-games readily available to scratch that exact itch of yours!
: Thanks, but I’ll probably stick to real humans for the time being.
scene mollycleaning3
: Gah. How boring.
: Weren’t you head over heels for an actual human being until just recently?
scene mollycleaning2
: Well...yes. But then I received a cruel reminder as to why I shouldn’t be getting involved in affairs like that in the first place.
: I’m happy that Rin is happy.
: Well, partially happy.
: And the other parts?
scene mollycleaning7
: Well...they’d obviously have to be unhappy, wouldn’t they?
: Unhappy why?
: Probably...the same reason I’m happy. Just spun around until it can’t stand up anymore and has to throw up all over the floor.
: It’s okay to just...not be happy, you know? I-
scene mollycleaning15
: Thank you, Sir. But I’d like to save a conversation as depressing as this for a time when it’s easier for me to escape into more allusions.
: Sure. That’s fine. I just don’t want you feeling down if there is an option to not do that.
: That is the issue, though, Sir.
: I deserve to feel down right now.
: I did a horrible thing. Not just once, but twice.
: If I get hung up on the fact that it did not personally benefit me instead of being happy for a friend or...whatever she is now, who finally got something she wanted...
: Well...I think I’d feel even worse about myself than I already do.
: So what, then? Are you just going to go back to ignoring those feelings?
: If you get good enough at ignoring something, it eventually feels like it’s not even there.
: And while it might not sound like a storybook ending, that outcome would be better than anything else I can think of right now.
: It sounds good to me too.
scene mollycleaning16
: Yeah?
: Yeah.
: To be honest, I was expecting you to be doing a lot worse than you actually are.
: I know that you’ve been through some pretty rough shit in the past, but I also know that this was important enough for you to break down in my arms about before.
: But if you feel like you’re capable of just ignoring it and letting time do its shitty thing of taking forever to make you feel slightly better, go for it.
: Not like I can really help anyway.
: Oh, also, your last customer just left.
scene mollycleaning17
: A-ha! Then you can help!
: Please don’t make me clean the store. I don’t work here.
scene mollycleaning18
: So you’ll do anything possible to cheer me up except for helping me do my job?
: I don’t think I ever said anything.
: I believe it was implied, Sir.
: Are you not aware of my incapability to perform at my full potential right now?
: There is a darkness growing within me that is sucking out my life essence as we speak. How would you feel in my shoes?!
: Eh. Getting life juice sucked out of me doesn’t sound too bad right now.
scene mollycleaning19
: W-Well...no! I guess...it would make sense for you to say that!
: But I would still very much appreciate it if you could, at the very least, place the chairs on top of all of the tables.
scene mollycleaning20
: As a...one time favor to me for...not making your life as difficult as you expected me to tonight.
: And also if you’d walk me home after we’re done.
: So a two time favor.
: One time consisting of two things.
: Maybe a third when we get back to the dorm. Who knows?
: Can you do me a favor when we get back to the dorm?
: Is this favor you have in mind a lewd one?
: Is it allowed to be a lewd one?
: Is my name Molly Medb MacCormack?
: ...Maybe?
: Wrong! It is Molly Moyra MacCormack!
: Why do you not know this?!
: It wasn’t in your character profile.
: Silence! Chairs! Go go go!
scene black
I sigh to myself and somehow let Molly bully me into helping out in some way.
I really don’t care as much as I made it seem, though.
It’s not like this place has that many chairs...and the ones they do have are relatively light.
As such, I’m able to finish the task in several minutes and proceed to wait by the counter (That lives to see another day) for Molly to finish her portion of the work.
She does what I imagine is a half-assed job and finishes up in about twenty minutes before changing back into her winter clothes and beckoning me outside.
scene mollycleaning21
: Alas, the stars have retreated back into their caves in the depths of the night sky...preserving their light for the end of days as it steadily approaches.
: There are no caves in the sky, Molly.
: Of course I know that, Sir.
: I just mean that there’s a clear amount of light pollution here. It’s not like it was at the beach.
scene mollycleaning22
: Ah. I guess not.
: I wouldn’t really expect any less in a city, though.
: You don’t have to expect something before being disappointed, Sir. Sometimes, you can just...be disappointed.
: I like the stars. I wish the sky always looked the way it did when we were there.
: Don’t let Maya hear that. She’ll probably quiz you on them.
: I’d fail a quiz miserably. I just like looking at them.
: They’re okay, I guess.
: So, do you intend to venture forth on a side quest back to the dorm with me? Or is this where our party disbands and heads its separate ways?
: My answer to this question hinges on how long you plan on talking about stars for.
: I was already done, Sir. I was simply pointing out how I wish there were more.
: Then yeah. I can come back to the dorm with you.
: Excellent. I’ll see to it that you obtain a rather desirable quest reward as a result.
: Lewd or not lewd?
: Not lewd, of course.
: That doesn’t sound very desirable to me.
scene mollycleaning23
: Sir, I realize this may be annoying, but would we be able to stop somewhere along the way?
: Where did you have in mind?
: A nearby leyline I like to draw power from when my stocks begin to run low.
: Based on what I know about Mollyspeak...I’m going to assume that means a convenience store.
scene mollycleaning24
: It appears you still have much to learn then, as that answer is rather far from the truth.
: Come. Let us pick up yet another side quest and see if that one yields any worthy rewards as well!
scene black
